title: NOC Engineer
summary: A NOC (network operations centre) engineer watches an organisation's networks, servers and links around the clock and acts first when something breaks. You sit in a shift team that triages alerts, raises tickets and fixes simple faults, and hands harder problems to senior network or system engineers.
dailyDuties: Monitor network and server alerts on dashboards during a rotational shift
Triage alerts by severity and open incident tickets
Run first-level checks on links, switches and servers
Escalate unresolved faults to L2/L3 teams or the service provider
Join outage bridge calls and post status updates
Write shift handover notes and update runbooks
Follow change windows and confirm services after maintenance

skills.expectation: Watch network health on SolarWinds, PRTG, Nagios or Zabbix and act on alerts
Triage alerts by severity, open incidents and escalate to L2/L3 within SLA
Log incidents, problems and changes in an ITIL ticketing tool such as ServiceNow or Remedy
Troubleshoot TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP and link faults
Check routing, VLAN and switch-port faults and run first-level fixes
Run basic health checks on servers
Run basic health checks on servers
Write shift handovers and update stakeholders on outage bridge calls
Read Grafana or Prometheus dashboards for services
Check firewall and VPN tunnel status
Monitor AWS or Azure network components
Automate routine checks with small scripts
Check VMware host and VM alerts

groups.label: A server operating system (Linux or Windows Server)
